verification_scope: All completed result checkpoint hashes and full 218 CSV means/IDs checked by load_completed. Independently rescored the 12 saved L400 best/final arrays for nine metric/count fields, max difference 0. Not a fresh inference of all 218 images.

0005.same_count: L400 reduces whiteboard value error relative to B0 but leaves wall/ceiling error above R400. Whiteboard GT boundary remains missed; table/chair outlines account for modest F1 differences.
0005.increment: L200 to L400 changes are small visually. AbsRel 0.0639 to 0.0618, F1 0.345 to 0.383; no recovery of the board discontinuity.
0005.endpoint: Final lowers overall error 0.0618 to 0.0565 while F1 drops 0.383 to 0.338; more table-back boundary remains missed. This is a counterexample to the aggregate endpoint F1 gain.

0598.same_count: L400 reduces table-region error relative to R400; table perimeter matching improves slightly. Sofa boundaries and table legs remain missed.
0598.increment: L200 to L400 AbsRel 0.0500 to 0.0459 and F1 0.537 to 0.550. Coarse layout is very similar; no recovered fine table-leg geometry.
0598.endpoint: Final AbsRel improves 0.0459 to 0.0431 but F1 declines 0.550 to 0.533; no visually large structural change.

1440.same_count: L400 improves wall and floor value error versus R400, but both exceed B0 error. Chair slats and curved counter retain serious error and missed edges.
1440.increment: More images do not help this case: AbsRel 0.0982 to 0.1061, F1 0.546 to 0.522. Chair edges and counter miss persist; background error grows.
1440.endpoint: Final reduces background error, AbsRel 0.1061 to 0.0957, still above B0 0.0882. F1 rises 0.522 to 0.536 with some fewer unmatched chair fragments; counter mostly remains red.

0226.same_count: Both adaptations greatly reduce broad background/person depth error versus B0. L400 improves overall beyond R400, but thin branches remain displaced and small object edges missed.
0226.increment: L400 regresses overall 0.2174 to 0.2455 versus L200, although F1 increases 0.506 to 0.514. Front table objects retain bright error patches. This is not uniform benefit from more data.
0226.endpoint: Final improves AbsRel 0.2455 to 0.2100, with reduced front table/person error; F1 slightly decreases 0.514 to 0.511. Branch errors remain.

0246.same_count: Both adaptations worsen overall versus B0, with larger wall/ceiling and shelf value error. F1 changes little and fine shelf/chair boundaries remain missing.
0246.increment: L400 improves markedly over L200 (0.1854 to 0.1338) by reducing broad wall/floor error, but remains worse than B0 0.1129 and R400 0.1269. F1 0.501 to 0.512 is modest.
0246.endpoint: Final worsens AbsRel 0.1338 to 0.1763 with broad wall/floor error increasing; F1 is nearly unchanged 0.512 to 0.513. The strongest fixed-case late accuracy regression is preserved.

0080.same_count: L400 lowers overall error and recovers several shelf upright matches relative to R400/B0. Large portions of the shelf outline still remain missed; it is not a complete geometry recovery.
0080.increment: L400 retains lower error than B0 but is slightly worse than L200 (0.0688 to 0.0698); F1 falls 0.633 to 0.512 with fewer matching upright segments.
0080.endpoint: Final improves AbsRel 0.0698 to 0.0632 and F1 0.512 to 0.654, recovering more shelf upright matches. Unlike the L200 first seed, this endpoint does not erase the shelf-edge gain.

curve_review: Validation rapidly falls to best AbsRel 0.090054 at step 200, rebounds thereafter, reaches post-best maximum 0.096383, and ends at 0.092469 after ten stale validations at step 1200.
Online training loss continues down while validation remains above the early best: recorded late-loss-down/validation-up indicator is true. This supports an overfitting sign, not a causal diagnosis.
No qualifying terminal 500-step interval within 1% of best; stable_step is null. First AbsRel <=0.10 window starts 100 and is confirmed at 300. No <=0.09 target.
No AMP skips in this run. Differences from L200 cannot be causally attributed to skipped updates or sample size alone without additional controls, which are not added.
conclusions: Best L400 versus matched L200 improves AbsRel by 0.004085, about 4.34%, and delta1; conditional scene intervals exclude zero. F1 decreases by 0.008273, interval entirely negative. RMSE and boundary-band differences have intervals crossing zero.

Best L400 versus matched R400 improves AbsRel by 0.005201 and F1 by 0.011310; conditional scene intervals exclude zero. RMSE, delta1 and boundary-band intervals cross zero. This is one-seed evidence, not a final method ranking.
Best L400 improves all five metrics versus shared B0 in this seed with conditional scene intervals excluding zero. Failures on specific scenes such as 1440 and 0246 remain.

Final versus validation-selected best worsens AbsRel by 2.68% descriptively, while F1 improves by 0.006518 and boundary-band error decreases by 0.002690. Only the endpoint edge-related intervals exclude zero; validation selection makes this an endpoint diagnostic, not independent evidence favoring a different checkpoint.
Five of six predefined images improve endpoint AbsRel, despite the full 218-image mean worsening. This explicitly demonstrates why fixed-case visuals cannot substitute for aggregate evaluation.

LoRA has 73728 trainable parameters and peak allocated 4019.69 MiB; matched R has 27089 and 768.71 MiB. LoRA stops at 1200 versus R5300, but per-step cost differs. Recorded elapsed 759.33 s includes validation/scoring; attempt process wall 780.14 s includes setup. No isolated speed benchmark claim.
200 to 400 is an interim completed-count comparison. The planned 300-image runs will be added and used for adjacent-count increments.
The remaining two L400 seeds and all later planned methods/counts remain required; no architecture, loss, learning-rate, early-stop or selection-rule changes are made.
statistics_limits: Single seed: no training-seed standard deviation. Bootstrap resamples 62 scenes, 2000 replicates with seed 320119, retaining image weights; intervals are conditional on this training seed and unadjusted for multiple comparisons. No new test results.
